visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a warmly lit living room. A man wearing a black tank top sits on the floor at a low wooden table, eating noodles with chopsticks. In the background, a flat-screen TV shows a Korean makeup tutorial with two people visible. The room features wooden cabinets, a mirror, and home decor items. (2) The man continues eating and nods his head as if agreeing with the TV content. A POV text overlay appears at the top. He looks sideways toward the camera while chewing. The setting remains static, focused on the interaction between the man and the off-screen person filming. (3) The man turns fully toward the camera with an animated expression. He uses both hands to gesture around his face, mimicking makeup application techniques like contouring and highlighting. His facial expressions are earnest and focused. Small text boxes appear near his head, adding emphasis to his speech. (4) The man points specifically to his eyes and the bridge of his nose to explain details. Large, bold white text overlays appear on the center of the screen. He maintains high physical energy, leaning forward slightly as he gestures. The background remains the same living room environment. (5) The man stops gesturing and looks slightly puzzled as a reaction to a comment from the off-screen person. He blinks and tilts his head. The video ends with a close-up of his surprised face as the large text overlays disappear and the scene fades.
